questions.prompt: What is the intent of the Abstract Factory pattern?

options.text: Provide an interface for creating families of related objects without specifying their concrete classes
Let subclasses decide which single class to instantiate
Build a complex object step by step
Restrict a class to a single instance

questions.explanation: Abstract Factory is about families of related products. Single product via subclass = Factory Method; step-by-step = Builder; one instance = Singleton.

questions.prompt: The KEY difference between Abstract Factory and Factory Method is:

options.text: Abstract Factory creates a family of products via composition; Factory Method creates one product via inheritance
They are two names for the same pattern
Abstract Factory uses inheritance; Factory Method uses composition
Abstract Factory can only create one product

questions.explanation: Abstract Factory = family + composition (hold a factory object); Factory Method = one product + inheritance (override a method).

questions.prompt: Abstract Factory produces a matched ____ of related products that are meant to be used together.
questions.explanation: The point is a consistent family/set — e.g. all-light or all-dark widgets — so incompatible products can't be mixed.

questions.prompt: What is the main weakness of Abstract Factory?

options.text: Adding a new KIND of product forces changes to the factory interface and every concrete factory
It makes objects impossible to swap
It only works with a database

questions.explanation: The set of product kinds is baked into the factory interface, so introducing a new kind ripples through all factories.

questions.prompt: Match each concrete factory to the products it should create.
questions.explanation: Each concrete factory produces exactly one internally consistent family, so pieces always match.

questions.prompt: When is Abstract Factory a good fit? Select all that apply.

options.text: Products must be used together and mixing them would be a bug
You want to swap an entire set of products at once
You frequently add brand-new kinds of product to the set
The set of product kinds is stable, but the families vary

questions.explanation: Abstract Factory shines when families vary but the set of product kinds is stable. Frequently adding new product kinds is exactly where it becomes rigid.
